method: One snapshot, not a feed. Sportsbook moneylines from OpticOdds /fixtures/active + /fixtures/odds (is_main, five books); implied probability from American odds; no-vig = multiplicative normalisation of the two-way moneyline per book. Polymarket: Gamma event by slug (or the NHL tag listing), moneyline market, home outcome mapped by name; the CLOB midpoint of the home token is used directly as the probability (a sampled price, not a forecast). Each cell carries the vendor timestamp (OpticOdds line timestamp; Polymarket retrieval time).
